statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-48702 (GHSA-47q9-m4ww-924m, GO-2026-5778): Rekor's Alpine package entry type (Package.Unmarshal in pkg/types/alpine/apk.go) decompressed the signature and control gzip members of a submitted APK without a size bound, so a crafted entry sent to a Rekor server could exhaust its memory. Affected is github.com/sigstore/rekor 0.3.0 before 1.5.2 (https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/security/advisories/GHSA-47q9-m4ww-924m, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5778, fix commit https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/commit/759b98e2a7c39ea9779b6a51299c5f0f987f8802). Checked every scout-cli-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository by 2026-11-27: 25 builds, 1.20.4-r1 to 1.30.0-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64. Each holds /usr/bin/docker-scout, the -dev build of the Docker Scout CLI, a Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0; we read its Go build information from every published package. github.com/sigstore/rekor is v1.5.0 in 1.20.4-r1 to 1.23.1-r0, v1.5.2 in 1.23.1-r1 to 1.23.1-r9, v1.5.4 in 1.23.1-r10 to 1.30.0-r1; both architectures agree for every build. Only 1.20.4-r1 to 1.23.1-r0 carry an affected release (github.com/sigstore/rekor v1.5.0); 1.23.1-r1 and later carry v1.5.2 or later. We listed the symbols of the binaries for 1.20.4-r1 to 1.23.1-r2, which covers all of those builds, on both architectures with go tool nm and searched each whole binary for the function names (the Go function name table also lists inlined functions): none contains github.com/sigstore/rekor/pkg/types/alpine, while the same search finds other Rekor entry types (github.com/sigstore/rekor/pkg/types/hashedrekord) and runtime.main in every one. The Docker Scout CLI uses Rekor client and entry types for verification but not the Alpine package type, so the vulnerable code is not present in any published build.

CVE-2026-48702 (GHSA-47q9-m4ww-924m, GO-2026-5778): Rekor's Alpine package entry type (Package.Unmarshal in pkg/types/alpine/apk.go) decompressed the signature and control gzip members of a submitted APK without a size bound, so a crafted entry sent to a Rekor server could exhaust its memory. Affected is github.com/sigstore/rekor 0.3.0 before 1.5.2 (https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/security/advisories/GHSA-47q9-m4ww-924m, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5778, fix commit https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/commit/759b98e2a7c39ea9779b6a51299c5f0f987f8802). Each package has the same checksum in the repository index as the Alpine 3.23 scout-cli-dev package of the same version and architecture, so it is the same file, holding /usr/bin/docker-scout, the -dev build of the Docker Scout CLI, a Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0 whose Go build information we read. github.com/sigstore/rekor is v1.5.0 in 1.21.0-r1 to 1.23.1-r0, v1.5.2 in 1.23.1-r1 to 1.23.1-r9, v1.5.4 in 1.23.1-r10 to 1.30.0-r1; both architectures agree for every build. Only 1.21.0-r1 to 1.23.1-r0 carry an affected release (github.com/sigstore/rekor v1.5.0); 1.23.1-r1 and later carry v1.5.2 or later. We listed the symbols of the binaries in the Alpine 3.23 scout-cli-dev packages, which are the same files as the Alpine 3.24 packages, for 1.21.0-r1 to 1.23.1-r2, which covers all of those builds, on both architectures with go tool nm and searched each whole binary for the function names (the Go function name table also lists inlined functions): none contains github.com/sigstore/rekor/pkg/types/alpine, while the same search finds other Rekor entry types (github.com/sigstore/rekor/pkg/types/hashedrekord) and runtime.main in every one. statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-48702: Rekor decompresses Alpine APK signature and control members without a size bound, so a crafted package can exhaust memory; github.com/sigstore/rekor 0.3.0 to 1.5.1 is affected and 1.5.2 is fixed (https://github.com/sigstore/rekor/security/advisories/GHSA-47q9-m4ww-924m, https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-5778). The Go build information of /usr/bin/trivy in each of the 37 published trivy-dev builds for Alpine 3.23 (0.69.1-r0 to 0.74.0-r11), on both x86_64 and aarch64, was read for this decision. Builds before 0.71.0-r0 embed github.com/sigstore/rekor 1.5.0 to 1.5.1, which the advisory lists as affected. Builds from 0.71.0-r0 on embed github.com/sigstore/rekor 1.5.2 to 1.5.3, which the advisory does not list as affected.
